name: IMP-215 - Scheduled Conversion Outbox Consumer - Review Only

parameters.query:
-- READ ONLY candidate query. No claim or HTTP occurs while dry_run=true.
with cfg(client_id, cutoff_at) as (
  select * from jsonb_each_text('{{ JSON.stringify($json.cutoff_at_by_client).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb)
), candidates as (
  select co.id, co.platform, co.status, co.attempts, co.created_at, en.client_id, cfg.cutoff_at::timestamptz
  from public.conversion_outbox co
  join public.events_normalized en on en.id = co.normalized_event_id
  join cfg on cfg.client_id::uuid = en.client_id
  where en.source_system = 'impuls_crm'
    and en.client_id = any('{{ JSON.stringify($json.allowlisted_client_ids).replaceAll("'", "''") }}'::jsonb)::uuid[]
    and co.status in ('pending', 'failed')
    and co.created_at >= cfg.cutoff_at::timestamptz
    and co.next_attempt_at <= now()
    and co.attempts < {{ $json.max_attempts }}
  order by co.created_at, co.id
  limit {{ $json.batch_size }}
) select * from candidates;

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all().map(item => item.json);
return [{ json: { dry_run: $('Validate Versioned Allowlist and Cutoff').first().json.dry_run, candidate_count: rows.length, by_platform: rows.reduce((a, r) => { a[r.platform] = (a[r.platform] || 0) + 1; return a; }, {}), sample_ids: rows.slice(0, 10).map(r => r.id), claim_sql_gate: 'disabled until dry_run=false and live n8n gate is approved' } }];
